name: Larry Page

foundation.name: Carl Victor Page Memorial Foundation
foundation.relatedPartyFinding: Inside Philanthropy (May 2023) analysis of 990-PFs: 97.8% of ~$600M+ in grants 2017-2021 went to donor-advised funds (National Philanthropic Trust, Schwab Charitable), i.e., recipients that are not required to disclose onward grants; not a related-party finding per se.

onTheRecord.finding: Inside Philanthropy (Michael Kavate, May 10, 2023): foundation had $6.7B in assets (FMV) at end of 2021; nearly all of $227M distributed in 2020-21 went to a DAF at National Philanthropic Trust; foundation has no website, no staff, and its filings list almost no non-DAF grantees.
Charitable disbursements per ProPublica 990-PF extract: 2019 $642,934 (on $2.39B book assets); 2020 $31.3M; 2021 $196.3M; 2022 $276.5M; 2023 $286.2M; 2024 $286.1M.

notes: Foundation asset figures are IRS end-of-year book value from the ProPublica extract (total assets $4,451,884,704 FY2024; $4,024,325,038 FY2023; $3,826,155,231 FY2022; $3,530,742,616 FY2021). Fair-market value is higher (Inside Philanthropy reported $6.7B FMV at end of 2021). Officers Lawrence Page (Director/Chairman/President), Lucinda Southworth (Director & CFO), P Wayne Osborne (Secretary), all $0 compensation. Foundation also files 990-T (unrelated business income) each year 2019-2024. Giving Pledge: givingpledge.org/pledger/larry-page/ returned no page and a search summary states Page has not signed; treat 'signed: false' as needs-check against the full signatory list. Forbes real-time net worth $282.3B as of 9/26/26 (page last updated Sep 15, 2026). met5PercentMinimum left null: not computed because FMV assets not read from filing; 2019 disbursement of $0.64M on >$2.39B book assets is visibly below 5% but a private foundation has a following-year grace period, so no shortfall is asserted without reading Part XIII of the 990-PF. political2024Cycle: OpenSecrets pages returned empty via fetch; left null.
